title: Applications Open for the Samsung Innovation Campus Program
bodyHtml:

This term, a new AI in Marketing track has also been added to the program, focusing on the use of artificial intelligence tools in marketing and content creation processes.

At the end of the program, participants will have the opportunity to develop real-world projects that contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals.

Application deadline: 21 June 2026
Further information: https://www.samsung.com/tr/innovation-campus/

title: Conference on Employment of Individuals with Disabilities in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Opportunities and Challenges
bodyHtml:
Organized by: Istanbul University Research and Application Center for Persons with Disabilities (ENUYGAR)
Date: May 14, 2026
Time: 09:00 – 14:00
Venue: Doctorate Hall, Rectorate Building, Beyazıt Campus, Istanbul University

A conference titled “Employment of Individuals with Disabilities in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Challenges and Opportunities” is planned to be organized by Istanbul University Research and Application Center for Persons with Disabilities (ENUYGAR) within the scope of Disability Week on May 14, 2026.

Within the conference program, two separate panel sessions will be held with the participation of competent representatives in the field.

In the first panel, representatives from relevant public institutions, particularly the Ministry of National Education, the Turkish Employment Agency (İŞKUR), and the Ministry of Family and Social Services, will discuss policies, practices, and strategies developed within the framework of digitalization processes and artificial intelligence technologies for the employment of individuals with disabilities.

In the second panel session, private sector representatives will evaluate digital and AI-based practices developed for the employment of individuals with disabilities in the business world, as well as institutional experiences and examples of good practices in this field.

The conference will also include workshops designed to enable individuals with disabilities to directly experience artificial intelligence technologies and AI-based applications, thereby contributing to their career development. In this respect, the event aims not only to share information but also to involve participants in active learning processes.

Through this conference, it is aimed to strengthen the sharing of knowledge and experience among the public sector, private sector, and academia; to raise awareness of inclusive employment approaches; and to contribute to the development of policies and practices that support the effective participation of individuals with disabilities in the labor market in the age of artificial intelligence.

title: Horizon Europe Health Cluster Info Day
bodyHtml:
Coordinated by the International Projects Office (UPO) of the R&D and Innovation Coordination Office, a “Horizon Europe Health Cluster Info Day” will be held on 24 March 2026 for our academics interested in the calls of the European Union’s Horizon Europe Programme Health Cluster. Owing to the interdisciplinary nature of Horizon Europe projects, the event will address project opportunities to which academics from different research fields can contribute.

The event will provide information on the call topics published under the Horizon Europe Health Cluster and share up-to-date information on application processes, project development opportunities and national support mechanisms.

The event aims to give our academics who plan to apply to the Horizon Europe programme for the first time, as well as researchers who have applied before or wish to develop new project ideas, the opportunity to obtain information, evaluate project opportunities and communicate directly with experts through questions and answers.

Date: Tuesday, 24 March 2026
Time: 13:30
Venue: Aziz Sancar Amphitheatre, Istanbul Faculty of Medicine

Programme

13:30 – 13:45 | Opening Speech
Dr. Ferhat CANBAY – R&D and Innovation Coordinator
13:45 – 15:15 | Horizon Europe Health Cluster Calls and Application Processes

This session will give general information on the 2027 calls of the Horizon Europe Health Cluster. The presentation will cover in particular:

• 2027 call topics of the Health Cluster (Health Cluster, Cancer Mission, Innovative Health Initiative (IHI), European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP-3), Health Cluster Partnerships)
• Project application processes
• Project development and consortium building
• National support and incentive mechanisms

Speaker
Assoc. Prof. Dr. N. Selcan TÜRKER
TÜBİTAK EU Framework Programmes Directorate
Health Cluster National Contact Point
15:15 – 16:00 | Project Experience Sharing: eprObes Project – “Preventing lifetime obesity by early risk-factor identification, prognosis and intervention”

Speaker

President of the Hypertension and Atherosclerosis Society & Retired Faculty Member, Department of Cardiology, Cerrahpaşa Faculty of Medicine, Istanbul University-Cerrahpaşa
16:00 – 16:15 | Questions, Answers and Evaluation

In this session, participants’ questions on the Horizon Europe Health Cluster calls will be answered and project development processes will be discussed.

title: Informatics Talks: Generative Artificial Intelligence and LLMs in Transportation Security
bodyHtml:

title: Information Talks III 3: Networks to AI, Sydney to Istanbul with Steve Khaled Hajjaj
bodyHtml:
As the Faculty of Computer and Information Technologies at Istanbul University, we are pleased to host Steve Khaled Hajjaj as a guest speaker in the “InformaticsTalks III – 3” event.

Networks to AI, Sydney to Istanbul – Navigating 20 Years of Tech Evolution

With over 18 years of international experience, Steve Hajjaj is a highly accomplished Network and Cloud Architect known for his solution-driven mindset and leadership in high-impact transformation projects. Throughout his career, he has led complex migrations and modernisation initiatives at major organisations such as Telstra, NBN Co, Qantas, and IBM, transitioning from legacy network infrastructures toward AI-powered modern platforms. 


🎯 In this talk, he will share key insights on how technology architectures have evolved over the past two decades and what this journey means for the future—from networking systems to artificial intelligence.

🔹 All students, academic staff and industry professionals are invited.
🔹 The event will be held in English.

title: Information Talks II 2: Microservice Quality Assessment with Dr. Rahime Yılmaz
bodyHtml:
In the second session of the Informatics Talks, we are hosting Dr. Rahime Yılmaz this week!

Dr. Rahime Yılmaz will deliver a talk titled "Microservice Quality Assessment: A Deep Learning Approach for Predicting Maintainability of Microservices," where she will explain the fundamental concepts of microservice architectures and the role of deep learning in evaluating software maintainability.

Key Topics:

  • Microservice Architecture Concepts: An in-depth examination of the defining characteristics of microservice architecture and their importance in modern software development.
  • Microservice-Based Software Metrics: Insights into the source code metrics used for assessing the quality and performance of microservices, along with methodologies for their interpretation.
  • Data Augmentation Technique and GANs: Discussion on data augmentation, a crucial component in deep learning datasets, focusing on GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks) and their role in generating synthetic data.
  • Deep Learning Steps and Evaluation: Outlining the key steps in developing deep learning models, from data collection and preprocessing to model evaluation.

We look forward to seeing you on Tuesday, December 3rd, 2024, from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM in Istanbul University, Rectorate Building, Hall 1.

About the Speaker:
Dr. Rahime Yılmaz earned her B.S. in Computer Engineering from Istanbul University in 2014, followed by a D.M. in Mechanical Engineering in 2015. She pursued a Master’s in Computer Engineering at Istanbul University in 2017 and recently completed her Ph.D. at Istanbul Technical University with a dissertation titled “Measuring and Evaluating the Quality of Microservices.” Her research focuses on quality assessment of complex software systems, particularly microservice architectures. Dr. Yılmaz is currently a Research Assistant in the Computer Engineering Department and has expertise in object-oriented analysis, design, and software engineering.

title: Tech Talks: Mathematical and Computational Tools in Bioinformatics
bodyHtml:
Join us for a talk where some of the key problems in bioinformatics will be shown, and the mathematical and computational tools that people use to solve them. The talk will be in English.

📅 Date: 07/05/2024
🕒 Time: 15:30 - 16:15
📍 Location: Faculty of Computer and Information Technologies


🔍 Unveiling the Guest Speaker: Asst. Prof. Andres Aravena Duarte 🔍

We are thrilled to welcome Asst. Prof. Andres Aravena Duarte, Chilean researcher at the Molecular Biology and Genetics department. Mathematical Engineer and Ph.D. in Mathematical Modeling (University of Chile). Ph.D in Informatics (INRIA, France). An Applied Mathematician who can speak “biologist language”. Research in microbial ecology, ancient DNA, systems biology and rare genetic disorders.


🚀 About the Seminar 🚀

Molecular biology is a relatively new branch of science. Despite (or maybe because of) that, it has gone through several revolutionary changes. Technological advances in the last 10 or 15 years now allow scientists to produce huge amounts of data at very low costs. Therefore this has created the need of developing new mathematical tools to analyze and understand these results.

For nearly 80 years the emphasis of molecular biology was to perform repetitive and expensive experiments that did not require advanced modeling. Today the scenario is the opposite, but many researchers lack the training to answer meaningful questions. This presents an interesting opportunity for mathematicians who want to apply their abilities to areas that can have deep effects on health, industry and the understanding of nature.

In this talk we will present some of the mathematical questions that are relevant for modern molecular biology.


🎓 Don't miss this opportunity to be inspired! 🎓
